message.content:
Here’s a classic set of ingredients you’ll need to bake a moist, flavorful chocolate cake:

| Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a two‑layer 9″ round cake) |
|------------|----------------------------------------------|
| All‑purpose flour | **1 ¾ cups** (≈220 g) – sifted for lightness |
| Granulated sugar | **2 cups** (≈400 g) – gives sweetness & structure |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | **⅔ cup** (≈70 g) – deepens flavor |
| Baking soda | **½ teaspoon** – leavening agent |
| Salt | **¼ teaspoon** – balances flavors |
| Eggs | **2 large** – bind everything together |
| Whole milk | **1 cup** (240 ml) – adds moisture |
| Vegetable oil (or melted butter) | **½ cup** (120 ml) – keeps it tender |
| Vanilla extract | **1 tsp** – enhances aroma |
| Boiling water | **1 cup** (240 ml) – activates cocoa & creates steam |

> *Optional extras:*  
> • A splash of espresso or strong brewed coffee (adds depth).  
> • A tablespoon of sour cream or yogurt (extra tenderness).  
> • Cocoa nibs or chopped nuts mixed into batter (texture).

These quantities give you a balanced, fluffy chocolate cake ready for frosting or simple dusting with powdered sugar. Adjust the measurements if you’re scaling up/down or using different pan sizes.*
